description: Search the AgentScout directory of AI agent tools and MCP servers by keyword, with optional category, pricing, open-source and data-locality (runs_locally) filters. Each result has data_locality (offline, self_hosted, cloud or unknown) with a plain note. Returns up to 25 matches with pricing as the maker states it and the AgentScout listing URL.

category.description: Exact category name from list_categories, e.g. 'MCP servers'.

pricing.description: Pricing type. 'freemium' = free plan plus paid plans.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. 'browser automation' or 'postgres'. Optional if a filter is set.

runs_locally.description: Where the tool can run, so data can stay on your side. 'offline' = runs fully on your own machine (e.g. with local models). 'self_hosted_or_offline' = also includes tools you can deploy on your own server. 'any' (default) = no filter. Based on what each listing says; tools without clear evidence are excluded from both filters.

name: search_tools
title: Search AI agent tools
